description: Excel collation of the scripts and symbol blocks T-3276 left unprobed (T-3559): 155 strings in Data!A1:A155 (Bengali, Gurmukhi, Tamil, Telugu, Georgian, Armenian, Ethiopic, Mongolian, Tibetan, Khmer, Myanmar letters with a combining mark; Thai and Lao vowels and prevowels; Hebrew points and cantillation, Arabic harakat and lam-alef; math, box, currency, CJK punctuation, letterlike and geometric symbols; arrows, misc symbols and dingbats at T-3324's range ends; other scripts' digits; emoji with a skin-tone modifier, a ZWJ sequence, a flag and characters of planes 1 to 3; bracketed by T-3276's anchors). Calc!A = count of Data strings less than each, B = count equal, C = exact MATCH position, D = XMATCH position, E = COUNTIF with "="&x; Calc!G1:G25 = (x<y)+2*(x=y)+4*(x>y) for chosen pairs (™ against tm, ∞ against punctuation, digits against 3).
